_note: Home-page content sources. Editable by the HoD. Quotes rotate one per day. News is fetched from the listed public pages/feeds, cached, and always shown with its source link.

quotes.text: Learn thoroughly what should be learnt, and then live by that learning.
quotes.author: Thirukkural, Kural 391 (translation)

quotes.text: As deep as you dig a well in the sand, so much water springs; as much as you learn, so much wisdom flows.
quotes.author: Thirukkural, Kural 396 (translation)

quotes.text: Learning is the true wealth that never perishes; all other riches are not wealth.
quotes.author: Thirukkural, Kural 400 (translation)

quotes.text: Whatever you hear, from whomever, wisdom is to discern the truth in it.
quotes.author: Thirukkural, Kural 423 (translation)

quotes.text: Those who resolve firmly will achieve what they resolve, just as they resolved it.
quotes.author: Thirukkural, Kural 666 (translation)

quotes.text: Dream, dream, dream. Dreams transform into thoughts and thoughts result in action.
quotes.author: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

quotes.text: Excellence is a continuous process and not an accident.
quotes.author: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

quotes.text: If you want to shine like a sun, first burn like a sun.
quotes.author: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

quotes.text: Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
quotes.author: Swami Vivekananda

quotes.text: Take up one idea. Make that one idea your life.
quotes.author: Swami Vivekananda

quotes.text: Education is the manifestation of the perfection already in man.
quotes.author: Swami Vivekananda

quotes.text: The important thing is not to stop questioning.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.text: Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
quotes.author: Marie Curie

quotes.text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
quotes.author: Alan Kay

quotes.text: Wherever the art of medicine is loved, there is also a love of humanity.
quotes.author: Attributed to Hippocrates

quotes.text: Quality is never an accident; it is always the result of intelligent effort.
quotes.author: John Ruskin

quotes.text: Research is to see what everybody else has seen, and to think what nobody else has thought.
quotes.author: Albert Szent-Györgyi

quotes.text: Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.text: Science is a way of thinking much more than it is a body of knowledge.
quotes.author: Carl Sagan

quotes.text: Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
quotes.author: Arthur Ashe
